answer_1.quote: We present AFRIDOC-MT, a document-level translation dataset for English from and into five African languages: Amharic, Hausa, Swahili, Yorùbá, and Zulu, created through the manual translation of English documents.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate performance using automatic metrics and compare the results of encoder-decoder models with decoder-only LLMs

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o as a judge, human evaluation, and qualitative assessment to compare documents translation carried out sentence-by-sentence and as pseudo-documents for selected models.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluation on a subset of outputs from GPT-3.5, LLaMAX3-SFT 1 , and LLaMAX3-SFT 10 for two domains, focusing specifically on translation into five African languages due to cost constraints.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator was assigned 80 documents to evaluate, tasked with marking as many spans as possible and rating the overall quality on a scale from 0 to 100. This annotation followed the error span annotation (ESA) protocol as implemented within the Appraise Evaluation Framework.
